my_sentences.en: Weren't you planning to / Didn't you say you were
my_sentences.ko: (과거 계획/발언 묻기) 상대방이 예전에 했던 말이나 계획을 기억해 내며 "~~할 계획 아니었어?", "~~한다고 하지 않았어?"라고 물어볼 때 쓰는 패턴입니다.
bold_words: Weren't you planning to / Didn't you say you were

my_sentences.en: Weren't you planning to move to New York?
Weren't you planning to quit your job?
Didn't you say you were taking a day off today?
Didn't you say you were studying French?
Weren't you planning to buy a new car?
Yes, that's right. But...
my_sentences.ko: (인정 후 계획 변경 알리기)상대방의 말이 맞다고 인정하면서도 "하지만 상황이 바뀌었다"라고 덧붙일 때 사용하는 자연스러운 연결 고리입니다.

my_sentences.en: Yes, that's right. But I changed my mind.
Yes, that's right. But I didn't have enough money.
Yes, that's right. But the schedule got delayed.
Yes, that's right. But I found a better option.
my_sentences.ko: (네, 맞아요. 하지만 더 좋은 대안을 찾았어요.)

my_sentences.en: Yes, that's right. But my parents didn't allow it.
eventually at some point
my_sentences.ko: (결국 언젠가는 특정 시점에) 지금 당장은 아니더라도 미래의 어느 순간에는 결국 그렇게 될 것(또는 하고 싶다)이라는 의미를 강조.

my_sentences.en: I want to buy my own house eventually at some point.
He will figure it out eventually at some point.
We need to talk about this eventually at some point.
my_sentences.ko: (우리는 결국 언젠가는 이 얘길 해야 해요.)

my_sentences.en: I'll have to tell her the truth eventually at some point.
my_sentences.ko: (결국 언젠가는 그녀에게 진실을 말해야 할 거예요.)

my_sentences.en: Every machine breaks down eventually at some point.
my_sentences.ko: (모든 기계는 결국 언젠가는 고장 나기 마련입니다.)

my_sentences.en: come to an end
my_sentences.ko: (끝나다, 막을 내리다) 어떤 상황이나 사건, 기간 등이 끝이 나는 것을 의미합니다.

my_sentences.en: All good things must come to an end.
The meeting finally came to an end.
Their relationship came to an end last year.
I hope this rain comes to an end soon.
The long debate has come to an end.
put [something] on hold
my_sentences.ko: (~을 보류하다, 잠시 중단하다) 마치 일시 정지(pause) 버튼을 누른 것처럼 어떤 일이나 계획을 잠시 멈춰둘 때 사용

my_sentences.en: We decided to put the project on hold.
I have to put my vacation plans on hold.
Let's put this discussion on hold for now.
The construction was put on hold due to the weather.
She put her career on hold to raise her kids.
my_sentences.ko: (그녀는 아이들을 키우기 위해 커리어를 잠시 중단했습니다.)

my_sentences.en: have second thoughts
my_sentences.ko: (다시 생각해보게 되다, 마음이 흔들리다) 이미 결정을 내렸거나 하려고 했던 일에 대해 의구심이 생겨 마음이 바뀌려 할 때(주로 안 하는 쪽으로) 씁니다.

my_sentences.en: I'm having second thoughts about buying this house.
my_sentences.ko: (이 집을 사는 것에 대해 다시 생각해보게 되네요.)

my_sentences.en: Are you having second thoughts?
We accepted the offer, but now we're having second thoughts.
my_sentences.ko: (제안을 수락하긴 했지만, 지금은 다시 생각해보고 있어요.)

my_sentences.en: He started having second thoughts about the wedding.
Don't tell me you're having second thoughts now!
